title: mail-server Email/query never returns unsupportedSort
description: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/email.rs (handle_email_query ~line 841, handle_email_query_changes ~line 1089) decodes EmailComparator but never rejects an unsupported property or an unrecognised collation; it passes sort straight to the backend. RFC 8620 §5.5 unsupportedSort: 'includes a property the server does not support sorting on or a collation method it does not recognise'. Mirror JMAP-vzgi (Mailbox/EmailSubmission/SieveScript accept only i;octet). Found while fixing JMAP-vzgi.
